source_semantics.RACH: Finite admissible causal set after current constraints/evidence; causal multiplicity retained rather than forced to one winner.
source_semantics.MRM: Response-equivalence/candidate-safe quotient over retained mechanisms for declared actions and target.
source_semantics.CED: Reliability-qualified evidence classes and deterministic-vs-set-valued target reporting criterion.

carrier_contract: Fix one ecological context and construct one latent bridge world for each RACH-admissible causal programme.
positive_claims: A causal singleton is not necessary for a deterministic mechanism-robust target when all admissible programmes agree at the required response/target resolution.
A reliability-qualified evidence class may contain multiple causal programmes while still licensing one response class or target value.
Evidence need only resolve report-relevant disagreement, not exact causal identity by default.
firewalls_preserved: RACH NOV is not converted into CED licensing value.
MRM response equivalence is not causal truth.
CED evidence licensing does not create the MRM response distinction.
Source theorem ownership remains in the source repositories.
claim_ceiling: Finite exact shared-carrier composition; no canonical natural-world embedding, no generic operator commutation, no empirical calibration, and no standalone quotient novelty claim.
